entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Thomas Wentworth, 1st Earl of Strafford,, also known in Jacobite Peerage as the 1st Duke of Strafford and 3rd Baron Raby from 1695 to 1711, was an English peer, diplomat and statesman who served as First Lord of the Admiralty.
